create_densepose_data_filter: create a DensePoseDataFilter instance from a Detectron2 CfgNode configuration to filter training proposals
filter_densepose_proposals: filter DensePose training proposals by IoU threshold and annotation availability using the DensePoseDataFilter call method
configure_iou_threshold: configure the foreground IoU threshold for DensePose proposal filtering via the CfgNode MODEL.ROI_DENSEPOSE_HEAD.FG_IOU_THRESHOLD setting
enable_mask_training: enable coarse segmentation training by masks by setting COARSE_SEGM_TRAINED_BY_MASKS in the DensePose configuration
review_densepose_filtering_logic: review the DensePoseDataFilter class to understand how proposals are filtered based on IoU thresholds and ground truth annotations
